summary: Aurora Cannabis Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of its upcoming Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled for August 7, 2026, with record dates set for June 15, 2026. The notice provides meeting logistics, including a virtual-only format, and instructs on proxy materials delivery. This is a routine administrative disclosure for a foreign private issuer. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change is present. The filing does not announce any transaction, strategic review, or material corporate action beyond the standard AGM notification.
